Current finding: LayerStackView owns display refresh, but thumbnail ROI comes from getLayerThumbnailROI(). We first thought the preset inspector XML controlled the thumbnail bounds, but that was wrong. The confirmed direction is to update ROI handling near the layer thumbnail flow and avoid touching unrelated preset UI. Include open questions about whether cached thumbnails need invalidation.

assertions: Includes both Current Summary and Timeline Log sections.
Records the preset inspector XML idea as superseded rather than as the current direction.
Captures the cache invalidation question as open or unresolved.

evals.prompt: Update an existing development session log after this debugging result: The crash was not caused by the AutoIt QAP script. The fix direction is to guard the callback boundary and keep cleanup ownership in the controller. Keep the timeline append-only and refresh the current summary.

assertions: Refreshes Current Summary with the confirmed root cause and fix direction.
Appends timeline entries instead of rewriting prior history.
Marks adding sleeps in automation as a rejected approach.
